attributes.name: is_relevant
attributes.description: true only if the page is an aviation news article, press release, safety notice, or airworthiness directive (AD). false for index/listing/navigation/contact/marketing/other pages.

attributes.name: content_type
attributes.description: one of: news, article, ad, other

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: the main headline/title of the article

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: a concise 1-2 sentence summary of the article content

attributes.name: published_at
attributes.description: publication date in ISO 8601 format if present on the page, otherwise empty string

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: one of: Airworthiness Directive, Airbus, Boeing, Safety, General

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $json;
const now = new Date().toISOString();
return { json: {
  source_id: j.source_id || '',
  source_name: j.source_name || '',
  source_type: j.source_type || '',
  title: j.title || '',
  title_normalized: j.title_normalized || '',
  url: j.url || '',
  content: j.content || '',
  summary: j.summary || '',
  published_at: j.published_at || j.fetched_at || now,
  fetched_at: j.fetched_at || now,
  content_hash: j.content_hash || '',
  embedding: j.embedding || null,
  category: j.category || 'General',
  severity: j.severity || 'INFO',
  tags: j.tags || [],
  dedup_group_id: j.dedup_group_id || j.content_hash || '',
  classification_reasoning: j.classification_reasoning || ''
} };
